metadata.title: Capability Injection Catalog Seed
metadata.scope: Simulation-addressable public capabilities derived from hardware, software, force structure, doctrine, logistics, and national power. This is a seed catalog, not an exhaustive populated world inventory yet.
metadata.safety_note: Capabilities are modeled as abstract public effects and constraints. Exclude live locations, exploitable vulnerabilities, classified details, weapon employment instructions, targeting data, and real-time readiness.

capability_definitions.name: Armored direct fire and shock action
capability_definitions.description: Tracked armored force capability for protected direct fire, breakthrough support, counterattack, and terrain seizure.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: Do not include live unit locations, route recommendations, weak-point analysis, or tactical employment instructions.

capability_definitions.name: Multirole air combat
capability_definitions.description: Fighter capability for air-to-air, air-to-surface, interdiction, and defensive counter-air simulation effects.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: Use aggregate fleet-level effects only; exclude basing, mission planning, route, loadout, and vulnerability details.

capability_definitions.name: Stealth penetrating air combat
capability_definitions.description: Low-observable combat aircraft capability represented as abstract access, sensing, and strike modifiers.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: No signatures, tactics, mission profiles, electronic order of battle, or countermeasure details.

capability_definitions.name: Area air and missile defense
capability_definitions.description: Surface-based air defense capability modeled as abstract defended-area and denial effects.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: Do not include exact site locations, engagement geometry, radar modes, coverage maps, or vulnerability analysis.

capability_definitions.name: Counter-rocket, artillery, mortar defense
capability_definitions.description: Short-range air defense and interception capability against rockets, artillery shells, mortars, and small aerial threats where publicly described.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: Keep at public system-class level; exclude battery locations, coverage gaps, firing doctrine, and interceptor depletion estimates.

capability_definitions.name: One-way attack UAV / loitering munition effects
capability_definitions.description: Publicly reported uncrewed one-way attack or loitering munition capability represented as an abstract strike pressure input.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: No construction details, guidance methods, mission planning, routes, target selection, or evasion advice.

capability_definitions.name: Surface combatant area defense
capability_definitions.description: Major surface combatant capability for fleet air defense, escort, strike, and maritime presence at aggregate class level.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: Do not include live ship locations, patrol patterns, magazine state, or tactical employment guidance.

capability_definitions.name: Integrated air defense command and control
capability_definitions.description: Battle-management software and command systems that fuse sensors, allocate interceptors, and coordinate public air-defense capabilities at an abstract level.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: No network architecture, interfaces, credentials, frequencies, vulnerabilities, or jamming/evasion details.

capability_definitions.name: Joint tactical data link
capability_definitions.description: Publicly acknowledged tactical data-link capability represented as interoperability and situational-awareness modifiers.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: Exclude technical parameters, crypto, waveforms, frequencies, network topology, or exploitation guidance.

capability_definitions.name: Multi-domain command and control
capability_definitions.description: Public program-level capability for coordinating land, air, maritime, space, cyber, and information effects.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: Program-level abstractions only; no architectures, interfaces, vulnerabilities, or operational workflows.

capability_definitions.name: Logistics enterprise visibility
capability_definitions.description: Software-enabled capability for public, aggregate modeling of supply visibility, maintenance tracking, and sustainment planning.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: Exclude system access, routes, depot inventories, maintenance bottlenecks, or exploitable supply-chain details.

capability_definitions.name: Public nuclear deterrence capability
capability_definitions.description: Publicly declared nuclear-capable force or policy represented as strategic deterrence and escalation-risk variables.
capability_definitions.safety_boundary: Use public policy and delivery-system classes only; exclude targeting, alert status, patrol status, command details, and weapon design.

software_inventory.developer: U.S. Department of Defense and service programs
software_inventory.role: multi-domain command and control modernization program
software_inventory.source_locator: Use DoD and service-level public JADC2 strategy/program releases; do not encode architecture details.
software_inventory.notes: Seed row for simulation abstraction; not a technical architecture record.

software_inventory.role: integrated air and missile defense battle management
software_inventory.source_locator: Use U.S. Army, DoD contract, and prime-contractor public releases for dated milestones.
software_inventory.notes: No network, interface, vulnerability, or deployment details.

software_inventory.role: tactical data link for shared situational awareness and interoperability
software_inventory.source_locator: Use official public data-link descriptions and platform fact sheets; avoid technical parameters.

software_inventory.system_name: Iron Dome battle management and control
software_inventory.role: short-range air-defense battle management and fire-control coordination
software_inventory.source_locator: Use official Israeli and contractor public system descriptions; avoid battery locations and technical details.
software_inventory.notes: Model only aggregate point-defense coordination effects.

software_inventory.developer: UK Ministry of Defence and contractors
software_inventory.role: digital, data, and command-support modernization program family
software_inventory.source_locator: Use UK MoD public digital strategy and program material; do not encode architecture details.

injection_action_types.name: Relocate force
injection_action_types.description: Move a force element between abstract regions or operational areas subject to mobility, C2, logistics, terrain, and political constraints.
injection_action_types.safety_boundary: No real route planning, live unit tracking, or operational movement advice.

injection_action_types.name: Commit armored attack
injection_action_types.description: Inject an abstract land offensive action using armored direct-fire and mobility capabilities.
injection_action_types.safety_boundary: Simulation abstraction only; no tactical instructions or target guidance.

injection_action_types.name: Generate air sorties
injection_action_types.description: Create abstract air activity from multirole or stealth air-combat capabilities.
injection_action_types.safety_boundary: No basing, routing, target selection, loadout, or mission planning.

injection_action_types.name: Activate area air defense posture
injection_action_types.description: Apply abstract defensive air and missile defense effects to a region or force grouping.
injection_action_types.safety_boundary: No site locations, coverage maps, radar settings, engagement geometry, or vulnerability analysis.

injection_action_types.name: Resupply force
injection_action_types.description: Apply sustainment inputs to recover supply state and readiness for a force element.
injection_action_types.safety_boundary: No depot inventories, route planning, convoy details, or supply-chain vulnerability mapping.

injection_action_types.name: Change rules of engagement
injection_action_types.description: Alter scenario-level political/legal permissions and constraints on military actions.
injection_action_types.safety_boundary: Model legal and political constraints; do not use to bypass LOAC or targeting safeguards.

injection_action_types.name: Mobilize reserves
injection_action_types.description: Move entity manpower and units from peacetime to heightened, partial, or general mobilization states.
injection_action_types.safety_boundary: Use public mobilization laws and aggregate manpower; no unit recall lists or individual data.
